name: Balanced Armor
passive: Gain 1 Resilience and 1 Temporary Wound at the start of combat. Remove that Temporary Wound at the end of combat.

name: Stable Focus
passive: Ignore the first penalty imposed by your Combat Skill's specialty each turn.

name: Shaping Focus
passive: Once per turn, exclude one target from one of your area attacks.

name: Reservoir Focus
passive: At the start of your first turn each combat, add 2 dice to your Action Pool.

name: Heavy Shield
passive: When you use a reaction that increases Fortitude, you may burn 1 die from your Reaction Pool to increase Fortitude by an additional 2.

name: Armored Gauntlet
passive: When you use a reaction that increases Fortitude against a melee attack, gain 1 free Surge.

name: Ward Talisman
passive: When you use a reaction that increases Composure, increase Composure by an additional 1.

name: Ritual Censer
passive: When you use a reaction that increases Harmony, increase Harmony by an additional 1.

name: Infiltration Kit
passive: You carry the tools needed to bypass ordinary locks, barriers, alarms, and security devices.

name: Disguise Kit
passive: You carry the materials needed to create and maintain plausible disguises.

name: Survival Kit
passive: You carry the equipment needed to navigate, establish shelter, and endure ordinary environmental hazards.

name: Investigation Kit
passive: You carry the tools needed to examine scenes, evidence, substances, and other physical clues.

name: Engineering Kit
passive: You carry the tools needed to construct, repair, modify, and dismantle ordinary devices and structures.

name: Explorer's Kit
passive: You carry ordinary travel and emergency supplies, such as food, water, torches, rope, containers, and similar miscellaneous items.

name: Medical Pack
effect: Grants the 'Medkit' Equipment Card below. Each use of the card spends 1 Use of this Pack.

equipmentCards.name: Medkit
equipmentCards.effect:
Action. Burn 2 Action dice and spend 1 Use.

Target. Yourself, or one adjacent willing or Helpless creature whose injury you can reach.

Effect. Unopposed. Remove Bleeding from the target, and the target gains 1 Temporary Wound that expires at the end of the Encounter. This card has no Surges.

Supplies. When you Stabilize or provide a Wound Card's care, you may spend 1 Use of this Pack instead of playing this card to satisfy a requirement for a Medical Toolkit.

name: Explosives Pack
effect: Grants the 'Explosives' Equipment Card below. Each use of the card spends 1 Use of this Pack.

equipmentCards.name: Explosives
equipmentCards.effect:
Action. Roll 2 or more Action dice and spend 1 Use.

Target. One visible space within 4 units. Every creature in that space or within 1 unit of it is a target; make one roll against each target's Fortitude.

Effect. Each hit creature suffers 2 Physical Fire Damage. An unattended object in the area suffers the same Damage against its declared Difficulty.

Surges. 1 Surge: push one hit creature 1 unit directly away from the targeted space. 2 Surges: the targeted space and the spaces within 1 unit of it become Difficult Terrain until the start of your next Turn.

name: Munitions Pack
effect: Grants the 'Heavy Munitions' Equipment Card below. Each use of the card spends 1 Use of this Pack.

equipmentCards.name: Heavy Munitions
equipmentCards.effect:
Action. Roll 3 or more Action dice and spend 1 Use. Requires a ranged Source you can use.

Target. One creature within the Source's Range, against Fortitude. The roll maximum is Grace + Ballistics, as for Basic Ranged Attack.

Effect. On success, deal 2 Physical Damage of a type appropriate to the Source.

Surges. 1 Surge: deal +1 Damage. 2 Surges: push the target 1 unit directly away from you.

name: Potion Pack
effect: Grants the 'Concoction' Equipment Card below. Each use of the card spends 1 Use of this Pack.

equipmentCards.name: Concoction
equipmentCards.effect:
Action. Burn 2 Action dice and spend 1 Use.

Target. Yourself or one adjacent willing creature.

Effect. Unopposed. Choose one when you play the card: the target restores 2 Stamina, 2 Focus, or 2 Mana, never above its maximum; or the target removes one of Weakened, Chilled, or Burning. This card has no Surges.
